subject: Closure: private deployment latency regression — artifacts & next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpathhealth.com>, support@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy: brief latency spike noticed during upgrade

Hi Lena / ClearPath team —

Heads up: during the scheduled private deployment upgrade that completed at ~08:50 PDT we observed a short-lived spike in control-plane RPC latency that impacted API round-trips for approximately 8 minutes for a subset (~7%) of your nodes. Our on-call detected the surge and we opened an incident (PD-82932).

What we saw: increased leader election churn + RPC queueing on management channel which caused some control calls to queue and retry; user-facing inference traffic mostly stayed within SLA due to cached proxies but there were sporadic 5-15s API call slowdowns reported by a few of your internal services.

Immediate steps taken:
- rolled back the rollout group A (the canary) to the pre-upgrade binary at 09:04 PDT
- applied a hotfix to reduce the new keepalive window that was incorrectly lengthened in the release candidate
- waved additional telemetry (trace ids and span dumps) to your team for verification

We are still collecting logs and a short bridge recording and will send a consolidated artifact pack. Apologies for the disruption — we know any increase in tail latency during an upgrade is unacceptable and we are treating this as an escalation.

I will follow up with a short post-incident package (root cause, timeline, remediation, and action items) within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy: brief latency spike noticed during upgrade

Thanks for the quick heads up. We saw increased 500/503s from our sidecar healthcheck on two services during that window and it caused a short retry storm. We appreciate the rollback. Please include the jitter/sampling traces when you send the packet — we need them for our own postmortem.

Lena
Lena Ortiz
SRE, ClearPath Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpathhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private deploy: brief latency spike noticed during upgrade

Hi Lena —

Attached is the artifact bundle we promised (evidence-logs-CPH-3471.tar.gz) along with the bridge call recording (bridge-recording-20270519.mp3) and our proposed action-item pack (closure-action-items-CPH-3471.pdf). Highlights:

- Root cause (summary): a configuration change in the upgrade candidate extended the rpc_keepalive window and the orchestration scheduler concurrently adjusted leader election timeouts; the interaction increased transient election timing and led to queue buildup for management RPCs. The overload was self-limiting once the canary rollback completed.
- Impact: 8 minutes of elevated management latency, 7% of nodes affected, short-term client retries leading to surface-level 5-15s latencies for some calls. No data loss.
- Fixes shipped: reverted the keepalive change and pushed patch 2.3.1-hotfix1 to canary group; we will promote after validation and an extended canary.

Action items (short):
1) We will add a synthetic heartbeat alert to the ClearPath private deployment that triggers at 3x baseline latency and notifies both Redwood infra and your SRE oncall.
2) We will tighten canary thresholds and add a staged ramp that pauses on a 2x latency SLO breach.
3) We will provide a replayable trace bundle for your team to ingest into your tracing system (included in evidence tar).
4) Redwood will apply a one-time service credit to your May invoice for the incident window; details to be coordinated.

Attachments: evidence-logs-CPH-3471.tar.gz (6.4MB), bridge-recording-20270519.mp3 (42s), closure-action-items-CPH-3471.pdf (1.1MB)

Let us know if you want a 30-minute readout with engineering — we can schedule this week.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: proposed customer credit and rollout plan for 2.3.1

Team —

Follow-up from the artifact review: engineering confirms the fix in 2.3.1-hotfix1. I recommend the following customer-facing steps before we close the incident:
- Offer ClearPath a pro-rated credit equal to 8 minutes * affected nodes * standard per-node rate (draft credit attached in closure pack).
- Schedule a 30 min validation window with ClearPath on Tue 5/25 to run the extended canary on a subset of their cluster (we will keep telemetry open and add synthetic traffic).
- Update our private-deploy runbook to add a preflight check for keepalive/election interactions and include a measured rollback window.

Mina — please confirm the canary schedule and add an alert on the synthetic heartbeat before we reach out to Lena.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Closure: private deployment latency regression — artifacts & next steps

Thanks, Neha / Rishi / Priyom — the artifacts look complete and the proposed mitigations make sense. We accept the offered validation window on Tue 5/25 (08:00 PDT). Please send a calendar invite and include testplan steps. On credits: appreciate the gesture; our finance team will confirm required paperwork.

We'd also like a short joint runbook review two weeks after the validation run to close any remaining gaps.

Best,
Lena
